headline: Policy Subcommittee reviewed Section I and Section J policy recommendations, including school choice issues
summary: The subcommittee reviewed new policy documents for Section I, including a letter from MASC, and discussed the table of contents issue. It also discussed Section J recommendations covering school choice, available seats, student services, and Chapter 70 funding and tuition. The next meeting was set for July 22nd with Mrs. Bozak invited.
